title: Bike trip to Ladakh
desc: My recent Ladakh bike trip with Capture a trip was an exhilarating experience overall. It was filled with incessant bike riding, some dangerous and some real smooth rides. The landscape and the views all around made it surreal. Kudos to our group captain and coordinator Rakshit for making sure the group stayed on time and course. We could see he went the extra mile for that. He also mixed well with the group and everyone treated him like a friend.Overall a good experience and kudos to capture a trip for arranging that.
name: Pranav Vashishtha

title: Amazing trip
desc: I just finished an unforgettable bike trip to Ladakh with Capture A Trip. It was the most exciting and humbling experience.Our trip captains Tushar, Vaibhav and Arpit made the trip a truly memorable. Equipped with their knowledge and love for the travelling, they made sure we experienced the true essence of Ladakh while trying their best to make everyone feel at home.I highly recommend this Ladakh bike expedition with Capture a Trip to anyone looking for an adventurous and unforgettable experience. Many thanks to Tushar, Vaibhav, and Arpit for an incredible journey!
name: Prakhar Bangaria

title: Best trip in my life
desc: Our group of 14 individuals embarked on a thrilling Ladakh bike trip with Capture a Trip. Our trip captains, Ishaan and Saurabh, exhibited exceptional leadership skills, making our journey truly unforgettable. They were not only great leaders but also infused the trip with their infectious enthusiasm and wonderful personalities. With their guidance, we experienced a perfect blend of adventure and camaraderie. We are grateful for this memorable trip, filled with joy and cherished moments.
name: Ankit Kumar

title: Amazing trip
desc: I recently joined CAT for Ladakh Bike Tour and it had all the elements that i had expected from it! Good Hotels, food, service and also they covered the whole itinerary that was mentioned. The expert captains (Tushar , Arpit and Vaibhav) were really helpful in all situations even on the off roading; they managed to get the bikes repaired asap whenever required. Kudos to the team and i would recommend this group further for other travellers as welll for budget friendly tours!
name: Shreya Zaveri

title: Bike Trip to Ladakh
desc: I planned Ladakh Bike Trip with CAT. And it was awesome. Our stay at every destination was wonderful. Food was good. And overall experience was fantastic. Both the captains were very supportive and helpful and disciplined. I would suggest to plan your next trip with CAT and experience yourself.
name: Vaibhav Khandelwal
